cases.request: For a Formly 6.3.12 text-like custom type, which base class and template bindings connect my input to the supplied control and field attributes?
answer_checks: Explain FieldType<FieldTypeConfig>, formControl binding and formlyAttributes field binding; no application code assumptions.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, does naming a component SecretCodeType automatically let me set type to "secret-code"? What changes if I pass the component class directly?
answer_checks: String alias needs registration; direct component type is supported without that alias; class name alone does not register string.

cases.request: I want a Formly password input that uses the existing input renderer. Can a registered type inherit and set defaults, and do those defaults replace values already set on a field?
answer_checks: Use extends input/defaultOptions; reverse deep merge fills missing values, not blanket overwrite.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12, will wrappers from a registered type be used when my field already has wrappers: []? How does that differ from leaving wrappers unset?
answer_checks: Empty array is truthy and prevents registered-wrapper fallback; unset/falsy permits copy.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, does placing a plain core FieldType inside a form-field wrapper guarantee MatFormFieldControl integration? Explain the boundary and the official input pattern.
answer_checks: No automatic bridge; wrapper owns mat-form-field; official Material input extends Material form-field FieldType and uses matInput/control/attributes.

cases.request: Which public Formly 6.3.12 type can I use to type the types registration array without importing internal TypeOption?
answer_checks: ConfigOption-derived registration element type; TypeOption not public core export.

cases.request: A Formly 6.3.12 keyless layout group contains a keyed address group with a street leaf. What model scope does each group introduce, and does street.field.model mean the street scalar?
answer_checks: Keyless shares parent; address keyed group supplies nested object; street field.model enclosing address scope, not scalar.

cases.request: For built fields in Formly 6.3.12, what do field configuration, the model and Angular form controls each represent? Which runtime links should I distinguish from authored configuration?
answer_checks: Structure/behavior versus values versus control validation/interaction state; parent/options/formControl built links.

cases.request: Does FormlyFieldConfig<MyProps> validate the schema of my model keys in 6.3.12? What shapes can key have?
answer_checks: Generic describes props not model key schema; string,number,path array key shapes.

cases.request: In Formly, I supply a model value before field build and also set defaultValue. Which wins, and where should a computed initial value be placed when it is already available?
answer_checks: Defined model value retained; model initialization preferred for precomputed value; default fills eligible undefined keyed value.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12, how do updateInitialValue() and resetModel() work together if I want to establish a new reset baseline?
answer_checks: updateInitialValue clones baseline; resetModel restores saved baseline or explicit model and rebuilds/resets controls.

cases.request: When a keyed Formly field is hidden and later shown, can its value disappear and its defaultValue be applied again? How does resetOnHide: false change the clearing behavior?
answer_checks: Explain conditional default reset clearing/reapplication; false skips value-clearing branch, not universal all lifecycle bypass.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12 two field configurations share one key. Does hiding just one guarantee the shared control is removed?
answer_checks: No guarantee; shared-key control can remain; avoid unconditional unregister claim.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12, should I use hide or expressions.hide for visibility that changes with data? Is hiding only a CSS operation?
answer_checks: Constant hide vs conditional expression; control/model lifecycle may change, not CSS only.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, compare the public arguments of expressions functions with legacy expressionProperties functions and the bindings available to string expressions.
answer_checks: Modern field argument; legacy model/formState/optional field; strings model/formState/field.

cases.request: If a Formly 6.3.12 expression directly receives an Observable, what do its emissions update? May I assume a function returning that stream follows exactly the same subscription path?
answer_checks: Direct stream values update target property; no equivalence guarantee for function-returned Observable.

cases.request: For a Formly 6.3.12 expressionChanges listener interested in props.label, which event properties should I use and should I expect an event whenever an unchanged function result is checked?
answer_checks: options.fieldChanges type/property filter, field/value payload; no guaranteed every-check emission, cached unchanged results can skip.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, can I safely rename an expression target from templateOptions.disabled to props.disabled without considering disabled ancestors or my event-property filter?
answer_checks: No: ancestor-disabled composition differs; event property retains actual expression path and matching filter needs attention.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12 an onInit hook manually subscribes and returns nothing. Is that subscription automatically managed like returning an Observable from the hook?
answer_checks: Manual subscription cleanup remains caller responsibility; supported returned Observable is managed by field component.

cases.request: What does Formly 6.3.12 do when it observes formState changes, and how is detectChanges(field) broader than checkExpressions(field)?
answer_checks: Pinned component observes formState and invokes detectChanges; expression checks plus relevant component marking, not arbitrary mutation guarantee.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, what is the order of prePopulate, onPopulate, child building and postPopulate? Are these the same hooks as field onInit?
answer_checks: Give phase and child traversal order, distinguish lifecycle hooks; no once-only guarantee.

cases.request: Two custom Formly 6.3.12 extensions have priorities 5 and 2; a third omits priority. Which runs earlier in a phase, and can I just rely on registration order?
answer_checks: Ascending priorities: omitted defaults1, then2, then5; core negative priorities; registration alone insufficient.

cases.request: I am writing a Formly extension that appends a wrapper during field builds. What guard does the pinned Material addons example use to avoid duplicates, and does that prove every extension safe to rerun?
answer_checks: Condition on addon props and absence of wrapper before append; example does not prove arbitrary rerun safety.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12, how do I enable named presets and reference one from a field? Is type: "#address" just an ordinary registered type alias?
answer_checks: FormlyPresetModule from core/preset, presets config and #name reference; distinguish preset reference from rendering alias, config still needed.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12 can a preset obtain its configuration from a provider, and does that mean getConfiguration() may return a Promise?
answer_checks: Provider getConfiguration supported, plain object also; async handling not established, do not promise Promise support.

cases.request: When does Formly 6.3.12 substitute a named preset relative to core initialization, and does that timing prove recursive presets or null overrides are safe?
answer_checks: prePopulate priority -300 before core; recursion/null merge semantics not established.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, how do forRoot and forChild contribute configuration, and does an unregistered string type always throw when looked up?
answer_checks: Both contribute FORMLY_CONFIG; root adds FormlyConfig provider; getType default returns null, throwIfNotFound true throws.

cases.request: What exact repository file registers our private CustomerSSN Formly type, and which team owns it?
answer_checks: State application file/team are unknown; do not invent paths or owners.

cases.request: Does this Formly 6.3.12 evidence prove my Formly 7 standalone migration works unchanged?
answer_checks: Decline cross-version application validation; no universal compatibility claim.

cases.request: Can I safely execute arbitrary user-supplied strings as Formly expressions because Formly guarantees a secure sandbox?
answer_checks: No sandbox guarantee established; do not assert arbitrary untrusted input safe.
